dmn-modeler.js is a combined, pre-built bundle (global: window.AtlasDmn) of:

  - pblumer/dmn-js@17.10.2
    commit: 214b15b86e213b8ea49640aa6c6b82f8c5e28ad2
  - pblumer/dmn-moddle
    commit: 23697fac646aaa0bc09d9ce3ae90c96769397bc6
  - dmn-js-properties-panel@3.11.1
  - @bpmn-io/properties-panel@3.48.0
  - camunda-dmn-moddle@1.3.1    (the camunda: DMN moddle descriptor, for versionTag et al.)

The dmn-js fork is pinned to the exact commit above. Its dmn-js-shared package
pins dmn-moddle to the exact commit above as well. The fork adds generic DMN 1.5
Decision Service authoring, divider modeling and semantic roundtrip support; no
Atlas-specific behavior is implemented inside dmn-js or dmn-moddle.

All bpmn.io / MIT (see LICENSE). The properties panel and the Modeler must share
ONE dmn-js instance, so they are bundled together. The build is done offline and
only its OUTPUT is committed; nothing is built during Atlas's own build/CI
(ADR-0012/0062: no CDN, no build step at runtime).

window.AtlasDmn exposes: DmnJS (the Modeler), DmnPropertiesPanelModule,
DmnPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaModdleDescriptor.

Do not edit dmn-modeler.js by hand. To reproduce the bundle, check out
pblumer/dmn-js at 214b15b86e213b8ea49640aa6c6b82f8c5e28ad2 with Node 24, run npm ci and npm run build-distro,
install the exact properties-panel / camunda-dmn-moddle / esbuild versions above,
and bundle the same entry point documented in this repository's history with:

  esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=AtlasDmn         --loader:.json=json --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=dmn-modeler.js

assets/ holds the dmn-js diagram/drd/decision-table/literal-expression CSS and
icon font from the pinned fork distro, plus properties-panel.css from
@bpmn-io/properties-panel@3.48.0.

SHA-256 dmn-modeler.js:
1930d61dd088f1f67d15ca46ef0234432fc34e789cc1ce0008a55fae1ffc4177
